summary: Re-centers physics/audio geometry data: computes the bounding box of a primary object, derives its midpoint, then for each of two scene objects (primary and secondary) offsets the object position and every packed vertex by the midpoint, clears per-child flags, and recomputes each child's bounding box. Called from the vehicle graphics scene loader.

operations.description: Skip all work when the primary object pointer is null.
Compute the bounding box (min/max) of the primary object into scratch floats.
Derive the box midpoint: average the min/max corners on the x/y axes and halve the accumulated z component.
Two iterations, one per scene object: the primary object first, then the secondary object.
Query the current object position as three float fields.
Offset the object position by the box midpoint.
Write the recentered position back through a three-field setter with a sub-call.
Query the number of child nodes in the scene graph.
Iterate each scene-graph child, retrieving it by index through the linked-list accessor.
Query the total element count of the child's packed vertex array.
Iterate every packed vertex, subtracting the midpoint x/y in the body and the z component in the loop increment; each vertex's xyz is recentered.
Clear flag bits on the child node word after recentering its vertices.
Recompute the 3D bounding-box extents for the child.
Rebuild the bounding box from the updated raw vertex positions.
Run a post-process sub-call after the bounding box is rebuilt.

clean_pseudocode: x += centerX; y += centerY; z += centerZ;
for (i = 0; i < n; ) { v = PackedArrayIndexLookup(i++); v[0] -= centerX; v[1] -= centerY; v[2] -= centerZ; }
